# Complete Edition (Part.1 + 2) Available Now!

Prepare for combat with Omni-Directional Mobility Gear and fly head-first into battle! Defy all odds and eliminate the Titans!

Attack on Titan VR: Unbreakable, the first-person action-adventure VR platformer based on the highly acclaimed manga “Attack on Titan” and the latest installment of the VR series. 

{1280368342833344}


Join the Scout Regiment as an aspiring recruit and help defend mankind from the Titan invasion.


# Omni-Directional Mobility Gear
Utilize the Omni-Directional Mobility Gear to maneuver through the air and combat the onslaught of Titans! 
{1195760871453526}


# The Titan Threat
Titans rely on their instincts to hunt humans and satisfy their insatiable appetites.
Overcome the fear of death and lay waste to the Titan army!
{1042373100565202}


# Distinct Weapons
Each weapon offers unique characteristics that can alter the course of battle and how it is approached!
{469443659357575}



**Additionally, the Thunder Spear Unlock Event is on the horizon. Join forces with Scouts from around the world and prepare to take on this global challenge.**

🔧Version 1.0.2289 Updates- Bug Fixes🔧

 - Addressed the delay in unlocking Part 2 content after purchasing the add-on
 - Other Minor Bug Fixes


🔧Version 1.0.2289 アップデート - 各種不具合修正🔧

・Part.2（アドオン）購入後、ゲーム内でPart.2の内容が開放されるまでに発生するタイムラグの改善
・その他軽微なバグ修正

🔧Version 1.0.2278 Updates- Bug Fixes & Improvements🔧

 - Multiplayer Improvements & Bug Fixes
        - Enhanced matchmaking logic to make finding matches easier
        - Added region display and error messages during matchmaking)
 - Fixed Game-Stopping Bug Caused by VFX Issues
 - Performance Enhancements
 - Gameplay Balance Adjustments
 - Other Minor Bug Fixes


🔧Version 1.0.2278 アップデート - 各種不具合修正🔧

・マルチプレイ関連の機能改善と不具合修正
　　- マッチングロジックの改善 (よりマッチングしやすい調整を行いました) 
　　- マッチング時のリージョン表示やエラー表示の追加
・VFX起因のゲーム停止バグ修正
・パフォーマンスの改善
・一部ゲームのバランス調整
・その他複数の軽微なバグ修正

⚙️Version 1.0.2223 - Blade Issue Resolved⚙️
Resolved the blade issue in Version 1.0.2207. Blades can now be returned to their holders during missions, enabling reverse grip combat.


⚙️Version 1.0.2223 - ブレードの不具合解消⚙️
Version 1.0.2207で発生していたミッション中にブレードを腰のホルダーに戻せない不具合を修正しました。これにより、ミッション中に「逆手持ち」での戦闘が可能になりました。

⚔️ Ver.1.0 & Part 2 Now Live! Join Co-op Battles and Face the Armored Titan! ⚔️

We are thrilled to announce that Attack on Titan VR: Unbreakable has officially launched Ver.1.0, and Part 2 is now live! Fight alongside friends in the all-new Co-op Multiplayer Mode and experience epic new chapters.

What’s Included in Part.2:

- 💥Later Chapters of Campaign Mode
Experience Chapter 3, Chapter 4, and the Epilogue, including the intense Armored Titan boss battle.

- 👥Co-op Mode
Join forces with another player in Co-op Mode to take on every chapter together, whether it’s a friend or someone from across the globe.

- 🔥Survival Mode
Test your limits in Survival Mode—defeat 100 Titans and prove you're among the elite Scouts!

- ⚔️New Weapons
Unlock and master new weapons to diversify your tactics and elevate your combat prowess.

Each chapter is packed with multiple missions, offering unique challenges as you fight for survival in a world dominated by towering Titans. Whether you’re battling solo or teaming up with others, every mission tests your strategy, reflexes, and courage!

Additionally, the Thunder Spear Unlock Event is on the horizon⚡️
Join forces with Scouts from around the world and prepare to take on this global challenge🌎️

🔔 Note: To play Part 2, please purchase the add-on "Attack on Titan VR: Unbreakable - Part.2".
ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
⚔️Ver.1.0 & Part.2 配信開始！⚔️

『進撃の巨人VR: Unbreakable』が正式リリースとなり、待望のVer.1.0とPart.2が配信開始しました！仲間と共に巨人に立ち向かうマルチプレイモードがついに登場です！

Part.2 に含まれる内容：

- 💥キャンペーンモード後半
第3章、第4章、エピローグを体験。鎧の巨人との壮大なボス戦も収録。

- 👥マルチプレイモード
フレンドや世界中のプレイヤーとオンライン協力プレイで巨人に挑むことが可能に。

- 🔥サバイバルモード
極限状態での生存を目指す新モードに挑戦。

- ⚔️新しい武器
戦略を広げる新たな武器が登場。

各章には複数のミッションが用意されており、巨人に支配された世界での生存をかけた多彩な挑戦が待っています。一人で挑むか、誰かと協力するかに関わらず、全てのミッションがあなたの戦略、反射神経、そして勇気を試します！

さらに、「雷槍解放イベント」が近日登場予定⚡️
世界中の調査兵団員と力を合わせ、グローバルチャレンジに挑みましょう！

🔔 ご注意: Part.2 をプレイするには、アドオン「進撃の巨人VR: Unbreakable - Part.2」の購入が必要です。

<Ver. 0.1.2036 Update>

[Performance Improvements]
Significant improvements have been made to the performance, allowing for smoother gameplay and an enhanced battle experience.

[Bug Fixes Based on User Reports]
 - Fixed an issue where there was a delay in opening the universal menu after pressing the Meta button.
 - Fixed bugs causing players to fall outside the map and other progression-stopping issues.
 - Fixed crashes that caused the screen to freeze and the app to close unexpectedly.

[Other Minor Bug Fixes]



＜Ver.0.1.2036 アップデート＞

【パフォーマンスの改善】
パフォーマンスが大幅に改善され、よりスムーズに戦闘を楽しめるようになりました

【ユーザーの皆様からレポートいただいた各種バグの修正】
・Metaボタンを押した際にユニバーサルメニューが開くまで時間がかかる現象の修正
・マップ外に落ちてしまうなどの進行不能系のバグの修正
・画面が停止し、アプリが落ちてしまう現象の修正

【その他細かいバグ多数修正】

Ver.0.1.1726 Update
- Fixed an issue where players could get stuck between fallen training Titans and the ground in the tutorial.
- Fixed an issue where the blade would rotate unexpectedly.
- Fixed an issue where the anchor would stick in the air under certain conditions.
- Fixed an issue where the new weapon unlock display would not appear under certain conditions.
- Fixed an issue where the journal could not be grabbed at the base.
- Fixed an issue where damage effects would not disappear.
- Fixed an issue where the edge of the vignette display was cut off.
- Fixed the discrepancy between the player's perspective and the characters' height settings.
- Adjusted some Titan behaviors.
- Fixed an issue where the anchor UI was displayed on the result screen.
- Fixed various UI display issues.
- Fixed other minor bugs.
